title: Midday Digest: Buchanan out for season (Mon Nov 16)
parts:
🩹 INJURY UPDATE

🩹 JJ Buchanan | WR | Michigan | SO | #59 WR (preseason: #83)

Likely out for the rest of the season with a shoulder injury (via On3, ESPN's Adam Rittenberg).

He was taken to the hospital after leaving the Nov 14 game.

🏆 Aaron Philo | QB | Florida | JR | #85 QB (preseason: #114)

Named SEC Offensive Player of the Week after the 21-14 win at Kentucky (via On3).

Which QB takes the honor next week? 👇
